2225-4863-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-4863-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3301-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3301-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3301-4828-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5170-6132-8175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1957-2530-7399--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
1957-2530-7399--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-864-2267-3125-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-6495.description:
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.
586-864-2267-3125-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2111-3545-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Repeat.

3756-4693-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1902-4091-7791.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
1902-4091-7791.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Wirewood Channeler.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.

328-3260-3967-4078.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-3260-3967-4078.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-3260-3967-4078.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1451-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Pyreheart Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
1451-6798-6972.notes: If Pyreheart Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-5570-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2511-5570-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

140-2852-7433.description:
Activate Doom Whisperer by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

3750-5526.notablePrerequisites: Lands and creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
3750-5526.description:
Animate lands you control using Kamahl's Will.
Activate all mana producing lands and creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat and main phase after this phase.
Repeat from step 2.

206-240-4050-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7330.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-6791-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

527-1409-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

567-3490-4017-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-3490-4017-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

985-2466-5051-5078.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Traxos, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2034-5113-5220.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
Realmwalker has a creature type noted that is found on the nontoken creature mentioned above.
2034-5113-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3967-4186-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
3967-4186-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

478-5527-6871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
478-5527-6871.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

1661-1987-2364-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

907-1479-6754.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Eusocial Engineering, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1355-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
1355-4067-5672.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
1355-4067-5672.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-4779-5123-5687.notablePrerequisites: You control no more than two additional creatures.
2558-4779-5123-5687.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Jetmir, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

527-1247-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Selvala and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
527-1247-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2060-2744-3327-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2060-2744-3327-5686.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4336-5220-5683-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Kobolds of Kher Keep and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1170-1645-2499-5478-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

914-1170--15.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the buyback spell with buyback.
Opponents control a number of artifacts and/or enchantments equal to or greater than one plus the number of Treasure tokens that would be required to cast the buyback spell with buyback.
There are legal targets for the buyback spell, if applicable.
914-1170--15.description:
Cast the buyback spell with buyback by paying its mana cost plus its buyback cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a number of Treasure artifact tokens equal to the number of artifacts and/or enchantments opponents control.
Resolve the buyback spell, performing its listed effect and returning it to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the buyback spell with buyback.
Repeat from step 1.

1409-1633-2039-2499-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Torrential Gearhulk is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1633-2039-2499-5195.description:
Activate Torrential Gearhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Torrential Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Torrential Gearhulk.
Resolve a Torrential Gearhulk trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

553-790.notablePrerequisites: You have at least nine cards in hand, or an opponent has at least seven cards in hand.
553-790.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and draw at least seven cards.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

549-1628-4186-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Necrosynthesis attached to Scurry Oak.
549-1628-4186-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

132-2645-3980.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.
